entities.title: Bring the older test targets into the AGENTS.md shape
entities.summary: Six test targets predate the test directives and don't follow them; AGENTS.md says such tests are brought in line when they are next changed.
entities.details: tests/conformance.rs, everyday.rs, operations.rs, purity.rs, text_form.rs and typed.rs have no `/// Verifies that ...` doc comments and no GIVEN / WHEN / EXPECTATIONS / THEN sections, use shared helpers (`date`, `codes`, `ctx`, `rules`, `differs`, `run`), and several tests check many branches at once (`operations::clarifications`, `typed::constructors_reject_invalid_values`, `conformance::envelope_rules`). tests/validation_codes.rs and the example suites already follow the directives. The fixture runners (everyday, text_form) are loops over shared files by design and may need a recorded exception (AGENTS.md 1.10) rather than a rewrite.
entities.compromise: The tests were left in their pre-directive form; AGENTS.md states the rule that they are brought in line only when next changed.
entities.cost: A failing test names a group of behaviours rather than one branch, and a reader has to read helpers and loops to see what is checked; the shape differs from the newer tests beside them.

origin.description: Section 1: "Tests that predate these directives are brought in line when they are next changed."
